description.fallback: After finally arriving in Egypt, the group travels through the Egyptian desert on their way to Cairo. They then wait for a helicopter from the Speedwagon Foundation whose crew is due to drop off a new Stand user who will accompany them. Joseph states that the Stand user has personality issues, and that that is why it took so long for him to join the others.
